# Keys, mouse and commands - the full reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-keys.py from the shipped keymaps and src/Plugins/jsplugs.yml - do not edit;
     run `python3 scripts/gen-keys.py` after changing a binding. -->

Every binding the shipped keymaps make, per platform. The short guide is [`usage.md`](usage.md).

- **macOS** is the window version on a Mac. **Linux** is the window version on Linux - and the **terminal
  version on both** (`--backend ansi`, or no display): a terminal never sends `Cmd`, so it takes these keys on a
  Mac too, with `Opt` as `Alt` (the terminal must send Option as Meta - see `usage.md`).
- `[Shift]+End`: `Shift` is optional - held, it extends the selection. *inherited*: the keymap it inherits
  decides (the Editor table).
- A view's keymap is looked up first, then the one it inherits (named under each table).

## Commands

Typed in quick mode (`Esc`, then `.name` or `.short`, `Enter`) or at the terminal's prompt. `!` after a command
(`.q!`) forces it where it asks first.

| Command | Short | Arguments | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.testcmd` | `.tc` |  | test command |
| `.help` | `.h` |  | help |
| `.hello` | `.hello` |  | hello |
| `.setlanguage` | `.sl` | language identifier | Set the language of the active buffer |
| `.listlanguages` | `.ll` |  | List supported languages |
| `.listviews` | `.lv` |  | List available views |
| `.hideview` | `.hv` |  | Hide a view |
| `.showview` | `.sv` |  | Show a view |
| `.isviewvisible` | `.ivv` |  | Tells if view is visible or not |
| `.quit` | `.q` |  | Quit/Exit Editor ('!' exits even with changes not yet saved) |
| `.newbuffer` | `.nb` | name | New Buffer / File |
| `.listbuffers` | `.lb` |  | List Buffers |
| `.copyoutput` | `.co` |  | Copy the last terminal command's output to the clipboard |
| `.outputtobuffer` | `.ob` |  | Open the last terminal command's output in a new buffer |
| `.closeactive` | `.cb` |  | Close Active Buffer (asks when it has changes not yet saved; '!' closes anyway) |
| `.closeall` | `.ca` |  | Close All Buffers (asks when any has changes not yet saved; '!' closes anyway) |
| `.openfile` | `.o` | filename | Open a file for editing |
| `.save` | `.s` |  | Save active buffer (asks when the file was changed on disk; '!' saves anyway) |
| `.reload` | `.rl` |  | Reload active buffer from disk (asks when it has changes not yet saved; '!' reloads anyway) |
| `.encoding` | `.enc` | encoding name (optional) | Show the active buffer's encoding; '.encoding utf-8' (cp1252, latin1, utf-16le, ...) sets what the next save writes |
| `.goto` | `.g` | line | Go to a line of the active buffer (counts from 1; the caret lands on its first non-blank; Cmd+[ comes back) - quick mode 'g' types '.g ' for you |
| `.fm_file` | `.fmf` |  | Reformat (reindent) the whole active buffer - not for languages where indentation is syntax (YAML) |
| `.fm_block` | `.fmb` |  | Reformat (reindent) the selection, else the enclosing block, else the line - as Cmd+I |
| `.saveas` | `.sa` | filename | Save active buffer with a specific filename |
| `.theme_reload` | `.thr` |  | Reload current theme |
| `.theme_list_colors` | `.thc` | theme color class | List colors for current theme |
| `.theme` | `.theme` | action and its arguments | Theme: list \| use <name> - switch theme (kept in the user config) \| --import <file> [--name <name>] [--force] - convert a VS Code / Sublime theme |
| `.config` | `.cfg` | action and its arguments | Config: [--user \| --project] list [prefix] \| get <key> \| set <key> <value> \| edit |
